svg.aria-label: One message's trip. Your desktop: White Noise and Marmot encrypt it with the group's MLS keys; keys stay in your vault, with no phone number, email or account server. Nostr relays you choose store and forward the encrypted event; a marmot mail carrier holds the sealed envelope, and relays see ciphertext, never words. The group: each member's device holds the keys for the current epoch, so this desktop app and White Noise on phones open it, and anyone removed earlier cannot.
